name: Monthly Profit and Loss
report_script:
# Path: your_app/your_module/report/monthly_profit_and_loss/monthly_profit_and_loss.py

import frappe
from frappe.utils import getdate

def execute(filters=None):
    columns = [
        {"label": "Year", "fieldname": "year", "fieldtype": "Int", "width": 80},
        {"label": "Month", "fieldname": "month", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100},
        {"label": "Total Purchase", "fieldname": "total_purchase", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
        {"label": "Total Sales", "fieldname": "total_sales", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
        {"label": "Profit / Loss", "fieldname": "profit_loss", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 120},
    ]

    data = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT 
            YEAR(posting_date) as year,
            MONTHNAME(posting_date) as month,
            SUM(CASE WHEN doctype = 'Purchase Invoice Item' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as total_purchase,
            SUM(CASE WHEN doctype = 'Sales Invoice Item' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as total_sales,
            SUM(CASE WHEN doctype = 'Sales Invoice Item' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
            - SUM(CASE WHEN doctype = 'Purchase Invoice Item' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as profit_loss
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                pi.posting_date, 
                pii.amount, 
                'Purchase Invoice Item' as doctype
            FROM `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii
            JOIN `tabPurchase Invoice` pi ON pi.name = pii.parent
            WHERE pi.docstatus = 1

            UNION ALL

            SELECT 
                si.posting_date, 
                sii.amount, 
                'Sales Invoice Item' as doctype
            FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
            JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = sii.parent
            WHERE si.docstatus = 1
        ) as combined
        GROUP BY YEAR(posting_date), MONTH(posting_date)
        ORDER BY YEAR(posting_date), MONTH(posting_date)
    """, as_dict=True)

    return columns, data
